7b4109b0597fc363e08f.en: The Sun is a star. The Earth is a planet that orbits the Sun once a year.
7b4109b0597fc363e08f.id: Matahari adalah bintang. Bumi adalah planet yang mengorbit Matahari sekali dalam setahun.

a3b9035ec2bcabbfa267.en: The Earth spins on its axis once every 24 hours.
a3b9035ec2bcabbfa267.id: Bumi berputar pada porosnya sekali setiap 24 jam.

d6aedc32669a73f684ae.en: The side facing the Sun has day. The side facing away has night.
d6aedc32669a73f684ae.id: Sisi yang menghadap Matahari (Sun) mengalami siang. Sisi yang membelakangi Matahari mengalami malam.

de9d1006aa84f8d5fd29.en: As the Earth spins, the Sun seems to rise in the east. Later it seems to set in the west.
de9d1006aa84f8d5fd29.id: Saat Bumi berputar, Matahari tampak terbit di timur. Kemudian Matahari tampak terbenam di barat.

a8478ba367ec52aaf8d6.en: The Moon orbits the Earth about once every 4 weeks. It reflects light from the Sun.
a8478ba367ec52aaf8d6.id: Bulan mengorbit Bumi kira-kira sekali setiap 4 minggu. Bulan memantulkan cahaya dari Matahari.
